desc: 直通宽松版型、水洗做旧质感、加深口袋与双线锁边
leaf: 男士直通宽松水洗牛仔长裤
name: 直通宽松水洗牛仔长裤款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用挂拍全景交代直通裤型与水洗层次，主图无任何文字。
一秒讲清核心主张：前幅与后幅平铺并置证明裤型，配三枚圆形短标签承接首屏。
shots.textZone: upper-right band holds the headline, the three round chips sit below it, garments occupy the lower-left to centre field

shots.intent: 放大普通窄脚裤紧绷、卡裆、膝部鼓包的穿着困扰，为宽松直通的解法做铺垫。
shots.textZone: top band centred headline, one short label at the bottom of each panel

shots.intent: 用腰以下裁切的低角度日常街拍让人代入，验证宽松直通裤型在真实光线下的垂坠。
以腰头、门襟与缝线的微距证明做工密度与洗水层次，替材质主张提供肉眼可见的证据。
同框同光对比自家丹宁与参考面料的纹理与缝线整洁度，让品质差异一眼可读。
shots.textZone: one label above each circular panel, a short proof line under both panels

shots.intent: 用平铺量位线与四档指数条回答尺码与厚薄弹力疑问，数值全部留作占位不臆造。
shots.textZone: garment on the left half with dimension lines, right column carries the headline and the four stacked index bars

shots.intent: 以腰头、口袋、裤脚三栏同光细节与空白证明位收口，消除做工与品质顾虑。
shots.textZone: headline across the top band, one label under each of the three panels

style.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF paper sweep for packshot and trust screens, #BBDCEA flat panel for infographic screens, real weathered concrete tones #B0ADA8 and #D7DAD8 for lifestyle and pain-point screens, one thin #FFFFFF rule line as the only graphic divider
style.iconSystem: thin-line round icons, single stroke weight, drawn in #2F4B6E on #BBDCEA or #FFFFFF, no filled illustration, no 3D badges
style.lightingSystem: cool soft studio light, front-left key with fill on the shadow side, visible raking side light at 30 degrees across fabric to render twill weave, drape and stitch rows, soft contact shadow only, 5500K except lifestyle at 4800K
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool washed-denim workwear menswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless #FFFFFF fields, washed denim tone #2F4B6E, info panel #BBDCEA and topstitch accent #C0762C, with all text in #2D2D2D; cool soft studio lighting, front-left key plus fill and a visible 30-degree raking side light across the fabric, soft contact shadow only; modern geometric sans-serif with thin-line round icons in #2F4B6E; real product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements, one headline plus at most three proof chips per screen; garment hung, flat-laid or cropped below the waist with the waistband at the top edge of the crop and legs falling vertical, stable garment scale and centre placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no visible faces.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent colors
no mixed fonts and no more than one headline per screen
no random backgrounds and no gradient sweeps
no inconsistent lighting and no flat shadowless macro shots
no mismatched icon styles and no 3D badges
no visible model face, head or recognizable identity
style.presentationRules: garment shown hanging, flat-laid, on a matched 90-degree overhead plane or cropped below the waist; waistband always at the top edge of the crop, legs fall vertical and unpressed; identical garment scale and centre placement across infographic panels; never a visible face or head
style.surfaceSystem: matte #43546A board for macro screens, flat #BBDCEA panel for spec screens, real concrete ground and steps for lifestyle, seamless sweep for hanging shots
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headline in #2D2D2D at 28-34pt, label in #2D2D2D at 12-16pt, maximum one headline plus three proof chips per screen, rendered copy filled from the project's verified facts
